Name: Key Suppressor
Author: Deflaktor
Description:
[size=5]Key Suppressor[/size]

Suppresses a configurable list of keys to prevent the base game from handling that key event whilst enabling other mods to still handle that event.

[size=4]Motivation[/size]

The [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Controls]Controller mapping[/url] in Stardew Valley often has multiple keys for the same action defined. For example the XBox Controller has three buttons for opening the menu (Start, Y and B). This mod aims to free up some of the duplicate keys to be used by other mods.

Some example mods which can be used with this mod:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/492]Billboard Anywhere[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1691]Data Layers[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7500]Horse Flute Anywhere[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7971]Drop It - Drop Item Hotkey[/url]

It does not always work though with mods which require a button to be held. These mods need to adapt their code to ensure compatibility with this mod.

[size=4]Configuration[/size]

Start the game and let the 'config.json' be generated. By default it creates a list you may want to modify:

[code]{
  "SuppressedKeys": {
    "DPadDown": "Suppress",
    "DPadLeft": "Suppress",
    "DPadRight": "Suppress",
    "DPadUp": "Suppress",
    "RightStick": "Suppress", // Suppressing this button removes the chat functionality. Useful for splitscreen.
    "ControllerB": "SuppressOnlyWhenPlayerFree", // Retains the functionality to cancel within menus, but frees it up for when the player is free to act.
    [...]
  }
}
[/code]
You can freely extend this list by other keys. See a list of possible keys in the Stardew Wiki page [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]Key Bindings[/url]

The following suppression modes exist:

- [b]Suppress[/b]: The key is suppressed in all circumstances of the game (even in the main menu, loading screen, etc.)
- [b]SuppressOnlyWhenPlayerFree[/b]: The key is suppressed only ingame when the player is free to act on the world (no menu is displayed, no cutscene is in progress, etc).
- [b]SuppressOnlyInMenu[/b]: The key is suppressed only ingame when the player is currently in some menu (inventory, chests, etc.)
- [b]SuppressOnlyWhenPlayerCanMove[/b]: Same as [i]SuppressOnlyWhenPlayerFree[/i] but the player is also free to move (e.g. not using a tool)

[/size]You can find the source on [url=https://github.com/Deflaktor/KeySuppressor]Github[/url]
